w1: Equation 6 at the sample points (eval_framework.w1); _own = vs the resample, _orig = vs the original realization; MedianW1_Eq6 = the one eval_framework.BOOTSTRAP_W1_REFERENCE selects
persist: share of valid fits whose mode count equals the original fit's

iqr: RAW, over the dominant (tallest) mode of each fit -- location in the realization's units, height as a density
